description: Compares two versions of a legal document. Identifies all changes (added, removed, modified clauses), highlights materially significant changes, flags changes that increase risk, and provides a side-by-side diff summary.

labels.description: Optional labels for the two versions.

new.description: Label for the new version (e.g., 'v2 Revised')

old.description: Label for the old version (e.g., 'v1 Draft')

new_version.description: The text of the revised / newer version of the document.

old_version.description: The text of the original / earlier version of the document.

name: compare_versions
